summary: The authors deposited 17,808 gene-level effects comparing infanticidal with allopaternal males in neurons. HypoExplorer pools all retained MPOA nuclei, and none of its four registered contrasts compares those two groups. The proposal passed validation, all 76 saved source files passed checksum verification, and no ledger was edited. [Author results](https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.28635458.v1) · [Analysis code](https://github.com/fdrogers/stripedmouse_parental_2025/blob/521ac9ae008b6448debaeb394879c3648e18dd14/Neurons_Pseudobulk_REV25.R#L71-L99)
openIssues: Author concordance remains unassessed for all four registered contrasts. Reassessment requires a whole-MPOA author result for at least one registered group pair.
The existing striped-mouse feature-mapping and dam–sire pairing questions remain open.
